tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul bzhugs so// yang dag lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / /thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs mgon la/ /rnyog med dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas/ /rmad byung gnad kyi gdams pa 'dir bshad bya/ /de la 'dir yang dag pa'i sgrub pa la brtson pas sa dang po'i rtogs pa brnyes pa dge slong ma dpal mos u rgyan gyi yul gyi rgyud rgyas pa las phyung nas sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga dang / bya rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs pa phyag stong spyan stong pa'i gzungs dang / zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs la sogs pa rnams la brten nas zhal bcu gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga bstod pa ste spyan ras gzigs la brten pa'i gzhung bzhi mdzad pa'i don nyams su len pa la/ sdig pa bshags pa'i cho ga nyams su len pa'i tshul dang / gzhung phyi ma gsum nyams su len pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la bzhi ste/ rten gyi gang zag dus kyi khyad par/ cho ga'i khyad par/ dka' thub kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po la tha mal pa sdig po che dang / thugs rje chen po la yi dam byed pa dang / gsang sngags gzhan nyams su len pa dang gsum las/ dang pos ni tha mal pa'i gzugs dang / gnyis pas ni thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal dang / gsum pas ni yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa'i nga rgyal gyis bshags pa byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i tshes bdun nas dgu'i bar ram/ bcu bzhi nas bcu drug gi bar ram/ nyi shu nas tshes gcig gi bar te nyin zhag dgu ni bshags pa'i dus yin la/ zhag re re la'ang brtson pa'i bye brag gis thun gsum mam/ bzhi'am/ lnga'am/ drug tu bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gnas dben par skyang nul la sogs pa byas nas maṇḍal khru gang pa la ba'i rnam lnga'am/ dri bzang gi chus byugs te me tog dkar po sil ma dgram zhes pa tsam las mi 'byung yang / dmigs pa gsal ba'i ched du dbus dang g.yas g.yon gnyis mdun rnams su me tog gi tshom bu bzhi bya/

de'i mtha' skor du mchod pa rnam pa lnga ci 'byor pa bsham mo/ /de nas maṇḍal gyi steng du pam̐ las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las lha gsum thod pa dang bzhi cig car du bskyed de/ dbus su thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon padma'i sdong bu bsnams pa/ sku mdog gser dang 'dra ba/ 'jam pa/ snum pa/ dbu rgyan du 'od dpag med bzhugs pa/ g.yon na sgrol ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog ljang gu/ g.yon na utpal 'dzin pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas phyogs su sbrul dkar po 'khyil nas zhal nam mkha' la gdangs pa/ mdun na thod pa dkar po me tog sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i thugs kar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thod pa dkar po'i nang hrīḥ'i mtha' mar gzungs kyi yi ges bskor ba/ rang gi snying gar yang de bzhin du bsgoms la/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa drag po dang / phyin chad mi byed pa'i sdom sems bskyed de/ rang gi lus kyang mang por sprul/ sems can thams cad kyis kyang sdig pa bshags par bsams la/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka'i yi ge rnams las 'od zer shangs bug g.yas nas byung / rang gi g.yon nas zhugs te yig 'bru la thim par bsam zhing gzungs ring gcig gis thog drangs pa'i gzungs thung bdun nam/ nyer gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa nus tshad bzla/ mjug dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ bzhi pa ni/ mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa byas na dngos gzhi'i dus su smyung gnas bya/ zla ba nya gsum la smyung bar byas nas/ bcu drug gi nyi ma rtse shar la bza'/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba la ni zas dkar gsum bza' zhing zhag gsum bzla/ yang na zas gcig pa zhag gsum bya'o/

/sbom po yan chad la sha chang spangs pa tsam gyis bya'o/ /khyad par du sngags pa'i sdig pa bshags na mdun gyi thod pa'i me tog yid kyis bsal la/ rang gi rnam smin gyi lus po der bcug ste 'khyags pa zhu ba ltar bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs la/ rje btsun ma sgrol mas phyag tshad byas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la drang bar bsam mo/ /de ltar gang zag bzhi las dang po ni tha mal pa sdig po che dang / bar pa gnyis ni pha rol du phyin pa'i lugs kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / tha ma ni sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i dbang du byas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gang zag gis stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gis thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal du gsal ba'i snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs par bsams la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal/ /gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ārya a wa lo ke shwa rā sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dī pe ā hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra nai widyā āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod pa dbul lo/ /de nas/ gang yang bdag gi dus kun tu/ /sdig pa bgyis pa gang gyur pa/ /skrag pas rmi 'drar 'chags bgyid cing / /deng nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid/ /dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing / /skyabs gsum la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ zhes pas rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par bsam/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas thams cad stong pa nyid du bsams nas/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus de nyid la zhugs pas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa gser btso ma lta bur 'bar ba/ lte bar hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu dpag tu med pa spros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bkug nas hrīḥl thim/ de ma thag tu padma hrīḥdang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bzhengs pa sku mdog dkar po lang tsho dar la bab cing 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ljang ba/ g.yon dmar ba de'i steng ma dbus ljang / g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng du dbus dmar ba/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang ba/ de rnams 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang ldan pa/

spyan gsum pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen la 'greng ba/ de'i spyi bor zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ rgyan spangs pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs 'dzin zhing 'dzum pa/ mgul pa dang bcas pa'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa bgrang phreng / gsum pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel ba/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na gser gyi padma yu ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pa na ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pa na mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis padma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil na spyan re re yod pa/ phyag rnams yar dbu'i gtsug tor dang / mar pus mo'i lha nga mi 'da' ba/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ras bzang po'i sham thabs can nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi ska rags dang ldan pa/ ral pa dmar ser 'khyug pas mdzes pa/ rin po'i che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ dpung rgyan/ dar gyi cod paṇa la sogs pas brgyan cing 'od zer dkar po 'phro bar bsam/ de'i thugs dkar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan drangs/ mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /rang gi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs dkar hūm̐ sngon po/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs su mos par bya'o/ /slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'od dpag med kyis gtsor byas pa'i rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas mchod pa lngas mchod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag pa yar lud pa las 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs rnam pa lngas dbur brgyan/ rang gi snying gar padma dang zla ba'i steng du rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs kar padma dang zla ba'i steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrīḥdamar po/ de las thugs rje chen po'i sku dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim par yun ring du bsam mo/ /bsgoms pas skyo na/ sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du bkod pa spro bsdu snga ma bzhin du bsams te/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ārya dzñā nā sā ga ra/ bai ro nā ya/ bhu ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksam̐ buddha ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ arha te bhya/ samyaksam̐ buddha bhyaḥ na ma ཿarya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twa ya/ ma hā sa twa ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭṭe/ waṭṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le/ pra tsa le/ ku su me/ ku su ma ba re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dzwa la ma pa na ye swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring tshar gcig gis sna drangs pa'i snying po ci nus bzla/ slar yang mdud 'dzin gyi rtsar sleb pa'i tshe gzungs ring re res sna drang bar bya'o/ /mjug tu ye shes pa mdun du phyung ba la mchod pa lngas mchod/ gsol ba gdab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol te/ dzaḥhi zhes lan gsum brjod nas gshegs su gsol te/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /thun mtshams su 'byung po thams cad la gtor ma sbyin par 'dod na/

rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du dkar gtor bshams te/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung / bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pam̐ las padma dang / bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ kham̐ las kha zas ro brgya dang ldan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par dmigs la/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i ngo bor gnas pa'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas de la bstim par bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas mi zad par spel nas/ yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong rnams kyis mtshon pa'i 'byung po rnams bkug cing spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bor byas te/ ljags la hrīḥs mtshan pa'i 'od kyi sbu gus gya nom pa'i zhal zas de dag drangs nas gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ a kā ro mu kham̐ sarba dharma ṇām̐ ādya nutpan na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ gzhan yang / phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa'i yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /mi'am lto 'phye mkha' lding dang / /yi dwags sha za grul bum sogs/ /'byung po'i tshogs kun 'dir byon la/ /legs sbyar zhal zas bzhes nas kyang / /mi mthun rkyen las byung ba yi/ /bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang / /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /ces zang zing gi dngos po byin la/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e wam̐ bā dī mahā shrā ma ṇaḥ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /bstod pa'ang thun mtshams su mdun du thugs rje chen po mngon sum ltar dmigs nas bstod pa yin gyi/ sngar gyi cho ga'i yan lag tu sbyar ba ni mi snang ngo /

/de ltar na bshags pa'i cho ga ni lam du ma zhugs pa'i tha mal pa dang / bya rgyud rang lugs ltar nyams su len pa dang / rgyud sde gong ma ltar nyams su len pa thams cad la sbyar du rung la/ sgrub pa'i thabs ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs ltar mdzad pa ste/ bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas/ cho ga tshar ba'i tshe ye shes pa gshegs nas dam tshig pa rkyang pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /nyams su len pa'i tshul yang tha mal pa sdig po che yin na sngar gyi bshags pa'i cho ga sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma byung byung gi bar du nyams su blangs nas/ de'i 'og tu 'di'i rjes su gnang ba zhus te bsgom bzlas la 'jug cing / gzhan dag gis ni dang po nyid nas rjes gnang zhus te bsgom bzlas la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ gzhung 'dis smyung gnas kyi dus kyi bdag bskyed bstan pa ni gtan ma yin te/ smyung gnas ni bya rgyud kyi lugs yin la/ bya rgyud la bdag bskyed med par ye shes rdo rje kun las btus su bshad cing / rgyud sde rang nyid nas kyang bdag bskyed ma bshad la/ don thob la'ang med pa'i phyir dang / gzhung las kyang mtshams med byas pa la sogs pas kyang bshags pa'i cho ga byed pa'i tshe nyi ma bar pa la zas mi za ba kho na la smyung gnas su bshad kyi/ gzhan rnams la ni smyung gnas kyi tha snyad byas pa'ang mi snang ba'i phyir/ de'i tshe sang nangs par tho rangs zas za ba'ang mi 'thad de/ bshags pa'i gzhung las/ bcu drug gi nyi ma rtse shar la bza' zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bya rgyud kyi lha la bdag bskyed sbyar ba ni rgyud sde gong ma'i cho ga ltar nyams su len pa yin la/ de'i tshe lus sdug bsngal ba'i ched du smyung gnas byed pa mi 'thad de/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ dka' thub dka' spyad mi bzad pas/ /bsgrub na 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /zhes sogs mang du gsungs la/

de dag gi don bsdus nas dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas/ bya ba'i rgyu la bdag bskyed med/ /bris sku mchod nas dngos grub len/ /bdag bskyed sgrub thabs yod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /de yi lugs bzhin mdzad pa yin/ /de ltar byed na smyung gnas med/ /bdag nyid lha ru bskyed pa la/ /mchod na bsod nams brnyes na sdig /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /'on kyang lus sdug bsngal ba'i ched du ma yin par de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungs pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pa yin pas nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pas ni rgyud sde gong ma'i rnal 'byor pas kyang nyams su blang du rung bar rje btsun gyis gsungs so/ /bod kyi smyung gnas pa dag gis bdag nyid thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mdun du maṇḍal la rdul tshon gyis padma 'dab brgyad dang / bum pa dang / gtor ma gsum bshams nas/ maṇḍal la dbus su zhal bcu gcig pa/ phyogs bzhir mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung / rnam snang / don grub rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed kyi phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa bum pa gang bar bsam zhing gzungs bzla/ mjug du bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun bskyed la bstims nas po bstod mang du 'don/ bum pa'i chus dang por mdun bskyed la khrus gsol nas/ phyis rang nyid la khrus byed pa ni sngar gyi gzhung bzhi po de dag gi don du mi snang yang / lugs 'di la brten nas dngos grub brnyes pa mang du byung 'dug pas brgyud pa'i man ngag gam dge slong ma dpal mo'i gzhung gzhan la brten par snang ngo / /rgyud dang rgya gar 'phags ma'i gzhung bzhin du/ /sdig pa bshags dang bsgom bzlas gtor ma dang / /bstod pa'i tshogs rnams nyams su len tshul te/ /'jig rten mgon pa'i gzhung bzhi bdag gis bshad/ /rnam dag dge tshogs kunda'i phreng ba ltar/

/rnam par dka' ba gang zhig thob pa des/ /rnam mang 'gro ba srid pa'i mtshor lhung rnams/ /rnam mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i gnas thob shog /dge slong ma dpa' mos mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i gzhung bzhi nyams su len pa'i tshul 'di ni rgyud sde bzhi'i lam gyi babs dang mthun par gzhung bzhi'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba'i mkhyen rab can chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi gsung la brten nas/ rgyal khams pa bsod nams seng ges gling kha bde ba can du sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhung bzhi nyams su len tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
